structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D). The page says 750 ₪ a month for 15 years comes to about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום" on 135,000 put in. I couldn't find what inflation rate it assumes.

stuck.where: אינפלציה button next to the sliders
stuck.why: Tapped it three times and nothing opened or changed. No inflation percent shown anywhere, just 'בכסף של היום'.
I typed 750 in the box but the slider seemed to sit at 800. Not sure which one counts (the total 135,000 matched 750).

findings.what: The 'אינפלציה' button looks clickable but nothing happens. The inflation assumption is never shown.
Results say 'בכסף של היום' without saying what inflation was taken off
Monthly slider shows 800 while the box says 750
Cheapest fund is from a house I hardly know (ילין לפידות), which makes me hesitate
Costs of 18,299 ₪ look scary until you work out from the legend that most of it is tax
Too many jargon chips that mean nothing to me
